newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Aug 19.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping Tuesday, Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.

Remnants of tropical depression Ignacio were spotted at about 330 miles (528 km) southwest from Mexico's Baja California state coast in the Pacific. The ministry said the storm practically dissipated and was drifting to sea.
Light to moderate rains were registered along most of the Pacific coast.
In the Gulf of Mexico, tropical storms drewg strong winds and isolated rains to the coasts of Campeche, Tabasco and Veracruz states.
Tropical wind storms in the Caribbean sent scattered showers of Quintana Roo state.
